info.title: NOBI Racing API

get.summary: Read authorized official headlines and direct source links
get.description: No grant means no ingestion and empty items with rights_required. Every read checks the operator grant file, validity and territory. Only fixed official RSS endpoints are fetched by the scheduled worker; no article bodies or media. Snapshots expire within 15 minutes or at grant expiry. No upstream calls from visitor requests.

get.summary: Read CC0 structured racing reference metadata
get.description: Scheduled Wikidata CC0 metadata synchronization, six-hour TTL, fixed three-entity allowlist. No official news or result claims. No separate rights grant required for CC0 item metadata. Disabled with nobi.open-catalog.enabled=false. Visitor requests never call upstream.

get.summary: Read personal loopback BBC Sport F1 RSS headlines
get.description: Disabled by default; personal mode requires a loopback server binding and reads require a loopback client. Fifteen-minute scheduled checks, no request-triggered upstream fetches, no full article bodies or media. Original titles, direct RSS links and publication dates. Business/public deployment rights are not granted by this endpoint.

get.summary: Read personal non-commercial OpenF1 weekend schedules
get.description: Fixed 2026 meeting and session endpoints, six-hour atomic memory snapshot, no live telemetry or results. Reviewed Chinese names and source-provided times. General deployment disabled; personal loopback mode only. Data adaptation is attributed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

429.description: Safe RFC 9457 problem; no provider payload or internal details

get.summary: Read completed-session championship reference and history
get.description: Personal loopback mode only, disabled in general deployment. Fixed 2026 season; hourly worker joins OpenF1 beta championship endpoints and driver metadata. Only race sessions ending at least 30 minutes ago qualify. Atomic six-hour snapshots, no live or authenticated upstream API and no visitor-triggered upstream requests. Historical missing rounds are omitted; missing latest standings fails closed. Chinese labels and derived charts are NOBI adaptations under the same data license.
